definitions.explanation: The sharp edge of a knife, sword, or other cutting tool. Refers to the blade portion specifically.
By extension, a sword or bladed weapon itself. Often used figuratively to describe something sharp or dangerous, such as criticism or harsh words.

examples.japanese: {刃|やいば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{包丁|ほうちょう}→包丁：04976_houchou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{刃|やいば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦こぼれている→こぼれる：02105_koboreru⟧。
examples.english: This kitchen knife has a chipped blade.

examples.japanese: ⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{刃|やいば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{研|と}いでいる→研ぐ：04377_togu⟧。
examples.english: The craftsman is carefully sharpening the blade.

examples.japanese: ⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{刃|やいば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{向|む}けられた→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧。
examples.english: The blade of criticism was turned against them.

examples.japanese: ⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{刃|やいば}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{時|とき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{刀|かたな}→刀：02194_katana⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧。
examples.english: The blade of words can sometimes be sharper than a sword.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{刃|やいば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{恐|おそ}れ→恐れる：02023_osoreru⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{真実|しんじつ}→真実：05316_shinjitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{語|かた}った→語る：01930_kataru⟧。
examples.english: He spoke the truth without fearing the blade of power.

notes:
Literally the cutting edge or blade of a weapon or tool. Widely used in figurative expressions to describe something sharp, dangerous, or threatening.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {刃|やいば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{研|と}ぐ→研ぐ：04377_togu⟧ — to sharpen a blade
- {刃|やいば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{向|む}ける→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧ — to turn a blade toward (also figurative: to direct hostility at)
- {刃|やいば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦こぼれる→こぼれる：02105_koboreru⟧ — blade chips/gets nicked
- {諸刃|もろは}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{剣|つるぎ} — double-edged sword
- ⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{刃|やいば} — the blade of criticism

PRONUNCIATION:
The kanji ⟦{刃|は}→刃：09865_ha⟧ has multiple readings. やいば is the kun'yomi used as an independent word. The reading ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ appears in compounds like ⟦{刃物|はもの}→刃物：11752_hamono⟧ (edged tool). The on'yomi じん appears in {刃|じん} (blade, in technical contexts).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{刀|かたな}→刀：02194_katana⟧ — katana, Japanese sword (the whole weapon)
- ⟦{刃物|はもの}→刃物：11752_hamono⟧ — edged tool, cutting implement
- {剣|つるぎ} — sword (more literary/archaic)
